name: Hasselt University
summary: Flemish university on campuses in Hasselt and Diepenbeek; its bachelor's are all taught in Dutch, and English-taught study starts at master's.

ib.text: Dutch-taught bachelor's need proof of Dutch: ITNA (B2), CNaVT Educatief Startbekwaam, NT2 programme II, or a passed year of Dutch-medium secondary school. UHasselt's own B2 test costs €105.

notes: UHasselt does not offer a preparatory year of Dutch; other Flemish universities do.
You can sit UHasselt's own Dutch test only once between May and September.
Medicine needs the Flemish entrance exam (toelatingsexamen), held in Dutch.
